title: Smart Tech II Automatic Transmission Fluid Exchanger Machine
lead: MOC has released the Smart Tech® II ATF fluid exchanger machine.
body: The following configurations of this machine are now available.
A Smart Tech® II upgrade kit is also available. This kit will upgrade an existing Smart Tech® ATF machine to the new Smart Tech® II machine.
benefits: Improved accuracy. The machine utilizes new float level sensor technology.
Automatically adjusts. This machine automatically adjusts for the technician's chosen dipstick service adapter.
